values: Purpose: build a small, human-reviewed set of normal road images with no visible road shadow. These decisions do not train a model yet.

Choose no_shadow_clear only when the road itself is evenly lit. Choose shadow_present when a physical cast shadow falls on the road. Choose unclear_exclude if you cannot decide confidently. Dark asphalt alone is not proof of a shadow.
